sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commissioner Against Corruption evaluated the Public Trustee’s systems to identify ways to prevent corruption, misconduct and maladministration.
sentences.support:
The recommendations in this report are intended to provide practical ways to advance comprehensive and 
effective systems

sentences.text: The evaluation focused on administering trusts and deceased and personal estates, together with preparing wills.
sentences.support:
The focus of this report is on Public Trustee’s practices, policies and procedures in relation to Public 
Trustee’s core business

sentences.text: The Commissioner concluded that integrity risks would remain high without the recommended changes and that adequate resources were needed to reduce them.
sentences.support:
Accordingly 
Public Trustee will need adequate resourcing in order to effectively reduce that risk.

sentences.text: The Commissioner made 19 recommendations addressing organisational arrangements, electronic systems, information security, training, customer service and estate assets.
sentences.support: I have made 19 recommendations in this report

findings.quote:
Many of the recommendations in this report would have the same effect but without the implementation of 
those recommendations, the risk of corruption, misconduct and maladministration will remain high.

notes: No separate executive summary or equivalent synopsis is provided. The Introduction sets out background, scope and methods. The evaluation did not assess investment performance or adjudicate individual complaints.
